title: Adaptive low-rank exponential integrators for large-scale differential Riccati equation
summary: Matrix differential Riccati equation (DRE) typically exhibits transient and steady-state phases, posing challenges for fixed-step time integration methods, which may lack accuracy during transients or oversample in steady regimes. In this work, we propose adaptive low-rank matrix-valued exponential integrators for large-scale stiff DRE. The methods combine embedded exponential Rosenbrock-type schemes and adaptive step-size control, enabling an automatic adjustment to the evolving solution dynamics.
